title: Build the unified harness and run the first features-plus-few-shot experiment
description:
## Purpose

Record the first unified experiment: features (A), few-shot by per-item retrieval (B), free neighbour-vote features (B-local), and both (A+B), on Jev.

## Scope (done)

Jev-Flywheel planted-bias sentiment corpus; 3 rounds × 100 scripted labels, label-order seed 1; iteration on dev-100; final comparison on paper-600 (not pristine). Analyst OpenAI `gpt-6-luna`. Plan: [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_PLAN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_PLAN.md).

## Outcome

Paper-600 accuracy after 300 labels: 0 = 0.767, A = 0.855, B-local = 0.853, B = 0.892, **A+B = 0.918**. A+B − better single lever = +0.027 (0.007 to 0.048). One seed, exploratory, no significance claims. About 6,000 Jev requests (2,400 dev-100 + 3,600 paper-600), under the 9,500 ceiling.

## Definition of done

Met: offline harness (eb6927f, 85cbb32), live run, published results (33f2afe, ef1f088), and the follow-up design (studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md).
